title: Man feared drowned after car trapped in flood at Sepang | FMT
text:
Man feared drowned after car trapped in flood at Sepang | FMT
The Selangor fire and rescue department said there were four people in the car, three of whom managed to escape.
The fourth person is missing after he was believed to have tried to swim to safety, the department said, adding that a search and rescue operation was being carried out.
